facts: The Endpoints table enumerates the five existing project option CRUD operations, with DELETE returning an empty 204 response.
Two ways to create options describes inline choices on property creation and later option CRUD; rename and default changes are option updates, not separate routes.
What you can write names name, description, is_default, external_id and external_source; sort_order is server-assigned and there is no reposition operation.
Options exist only for OPTION properties; nested project/property/option ownership, project-mode write conflicts and property read/write scopes are resource constraints, not additional actions.
